name: GPT Image 2.5 (Sunburst)
note: Top of the board for prompt following, fine detail and text inside images. Billed by tokens ($30 per 1M image output tokens), so cost moves with size and quality.

name: GPT Image 2
note: Elo is for the high setting. fal quotes $0.01 (low, 1024x768) up to $0.41 (high, 4K) per image.

name: Grok Imagine Image 2.0
note: All-rounder with low and medium quality settings and a 2K option. Elo is for the $0.06 medium setting.

name: Nano Banana 2
note: Fast generation and editing with accurate text and consistent faces for up to 5 people. Web search adds $0.015.

name: Nano Banana Pro
note: Older Google model. It costs more than Nano Banana 2 and ranks lower.

name: Nano Banana 2 Lite
note: Cheapest Google image model, under 2 seconds per image. Billed by tokens ($37.50 per 1M image tokens), which works out to about $0.04.

name: Qwen Image 3
note: Strong multilingual text in images (12 languages, 20+ fonts) and prompts up to 4,500 tokens. Elo is for Qwen-Image-3.0. The Pro version scores 1090 and fal does not say which one it hosts.

name: Krea 2 Medium Turbo
note: Fast, good-looking and very cheap. A strong default when you need volume.

name: Ideogram 4.5
note: Built for typography: posters, logos and text-heavy designs. Elo is overall preference at High. Low and medium cost less but are not ranked.

name: Seedream 5.0 Lite
note: Fast generation and editing from ByteDance.

name: FLUX.2 [pro]
note: Production-grade FLUX.2 with no tuning needed.

name: FLUX.2 [dev]
note: Open-weights FLUX.2 with good realism and text, LoRA friendly, commercial license. It defines Elo 1000 on this board.

name: FLUX.2 [dev] Turbo
note: Accelerated FLUX.2 [dev]. Almost the same Elo for two thirds of the price.

name: Z-Image Turbo
note: 6B-parameter model, very fast. Good for drafts and previews.

name: FLUX.1 [dev]
note: Previous generation. It now costs twice FLUX.2 [dev] and ranks far lower.

name: FLUX.1 [schnell]
note: Previous generation, lowest price on fal, clearly lower quality.

name: Seedream 5.0 Flash
note: Speed and budget version of Seedream 5.0. Not on the Artificial Analysis board yet.

name: FLUX 3 (image)
note: New model with native 2K and 4K output. A 50% launch discount runs through 8 Oct 2026. Not on the Artificial Analysis image board yet.
